COBOL.question: It was originally seen as a stopgap, but the _____ promptly pressured computer manufacturers to provide it, resulting in its widespread adoption

On 8 April 1959, Mary K. Hawes, a computer scientist at Burroughs Corporation, called a meeting of representatives from academia, computer users, and manufacturers at the University of Pennsylvania to organize a formal meeting on common business languages.

COBOL.subject: Computer & IT
COBOL.question: Representatives included _____ (inventor of the English-like data processing language FLOW-MATIC), Jean Sammet, and Saul Gorn
COBOL.fact: Representatives included Grace Hopper (inventor of the English-like data processing language FLOW-MATIC), Jean Sammet, and Saul Gorn.

COBOL.subject: Computer & IT

COBOL.subject: Computer & IT
COBOL.question: The Department of _____ was concerned about whether it could run the same data processing programs on different computers
COBOL.fact: The Department of Defense was concerned about whether it could run the same data processing programs on different computers.
